plausibility_notes: The museum gala and occupational cast are coherent for a theatrical party mystery. Pun names are genre-appropriate.
Several small concrete concerns feel natural: unpaid sculpture, last-minute display changes, conservation etiquette, donor menu instructions, and disputed ownership.
Almost every introduction lands on a polished joke or warning; the repeated cadence makes the cast sound collectively scripted rather than individually conversational.
The director's immersive-experience contingency joke and photographer's confession joke are conspicuously murder-party-aware, but do not identify a culprit.
Thirty introductions create a substantial recall burden. Distinct roles help, though several collectors and provenance specialists may blur until relationships emerge.
No alibis or character actions can yet be evaluated. I will not infer guilt from wealth, advocacy, expertise, or job access alone.
